Document CS0103 Colors/ColorHelper/FontWeights as a named common build error and clarify the bulk rewrite only remaps Windows.UI.Xaml, so unqualified Windows.UI.* helpers need an explicit using Microsoft.UI; / Microsoft.UI.Text; — recurs in most UWP code-behind.
